semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: 3d processing is a broad term that typically encompasses tasks related to geometry, making it equivalent to 3d geometry processing.

parent_domains.justification: 3d geometry processing is a subset of 3d processing.
3d geometry processing is a part of the larger domain of 3d data processing.
Modeling is a broader concept that includes geometry processing as part of creating 3d models.
3d vision may include processing geometry as part of interpreting 3d data through a visual lens.

closest_parent_domain.justification: 3d processing is the most directly related to 3d geometry processing, as both focus on the direct handling and manipulation of 3D geometry data.

child_domains.justification: Mesh processing is a specific task within geometry processing, focusing on mesh-based structures.
3d shape analysis is a part of geometry processing that specifically looks at the properties and metrics of 3d shapes.
Deformation is a more focused task under geometry processing that involves altering the geometry of 3D objects.
Mesh processing in general is a direct subset of 3d geometry processing, as it deals with mesh data, a common form in 3D geometry.

closest_child_domain.justification: 3d mesh processing is directly related to 3d geometry processing and deals specifically with the manipulation and optimization of mesh data structures, which are common in 3D geometry.

sibling_domains.justification: 3d modeling often works hand in hand with geometry processing to create coherent 3d structures.
This involves more specific tasks related to generating specific shapes within general geometry processing.
Reconstruction is a step often following geometry processing, making it parallel work in transforming 3D data.
Generation involves creating new geometries, closely related to processing existing ones.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: 3d modeling includes several aspects of geometry processing, making it closely related and often used interchangeably with these tasks.

unrelated_domains.justification: While related, representation focuses more on the conceptual depiction of 3d objects rather than processing geometry.
This domain deals more with interpreting entire scenes rather than the specifics of geometry processing.
A 3d scene is a broader context that includes more than just geometry processing.
Animation is concerned with the movement of 3d models, distinct from static geometry processing.
This involves interpreting or creating images from 3d data, distinct from geometry-focused tasks.
This domain is more focused on the creation aspect rather than processing existing geometries.
Similar to 3d generation, this focuses on creating new entities rather than processing geometrical data.
